meta.title: GitKit — Small apps built on your own git
meta.description: GitKit makes GitFolder and GitKit Kanban: small, local-first apps for Mac, iPhone and iPad that use your own git and GitHub. No accounts, no servers — your data stays yours.

hero.title: Small apps, built on your own git.
hero.subtitleHtml: GitKit makes two focused, local-first apps — GitFolder and GitKit Kanban. Both use the git and GitHub setup you already have. No accounts, no servers, no lock-in.

apps.title: Two apps, one idea
apps.subtitle: Keep your work in plain files under git — and get a native app that makes it effortless. Pick the one you need; they share the same principles.

items.name: GitFolder
items.tagline: Version history for your folders on Mac, and your repos as folders on iPhone.
points: Automatic snapshot commits when files change
Browse and edit your repos on iPhone and iPad
Uses your existing GitHub + SSH setup

items.name: GitKit Kanban
items.tagline: A kanban board whose only data source is a git repo of markdown.
points: Your board is a git repo of markdown files
One file = one card; history comes from git
Agents and scripts can populate it headlessly

principles.title: What every GitKit app shares
principles.subtitle: The same promises hold across the family — because the data is always just your files in your git.

features.title: Local-first & private
features.desc: No GitKit account, no cloud service. Your files move directly between your device and the git host you already use.

features.title: Your own git
features.desc: Both apps read and write plain git repositories you own. Nothing is locked into a proprietary format or backend.

features.title: Built on GitHub
features.desc: They lean on the Git configuration you already trust — the same repos, keys, and permissions.

features.title: Native, not a web wrapper
features.desc: Small, focused apps built with SwiftUI for each platform — each does one thing well and stays out of your way.

cta.title: Own your data.
cta.subtitle: GitFolder is on the Mac App Store and the App Store. GitKit Kanban is on iPhone and iPad.
